run_causal_gen_embeddings: run the script to generate and save token embeddings from a causal language model
extract_model_config_info: extract model configuration info including model type, vocab size, hidden size, and layer count
load_unreleased_model_class: load an unreleased transformers model class via dynamic import with fallback to AutoModelForCausalLM
save_token_embeddings_as_binary: save token embeddings from the last transformer layer as a binary float32 file
save_token_embeddings_as_text: save token embeddings as a text file with row index, column index, and float value per line
